articles.title: The key races to watch for the 2026 election
articles.snippet: While crypto isn't a major issue in the 2026 election, the industry will be shaped by who takes office in January. Here are the main races CoinDesk is tracking.

articles.title: Traders are already placing leveraged bets on Anthropic’s IPO using crypto contracts
articles.snippet: Trade.xyz’s new ANT contract fell about 20% in its first hour on Hyperliquid. There are no shares behind it, and U.S. traders are locked out.

articles.title: FBI and Secret Service join response to Binance’s $6.3B hack
articles.snippet: US agencies are investigating the theft and helping trace stolen assets, while Binance says about $3 billion has been frozen.

articles.title: Secret Service, FBI Join Binance Hack Probe as Circle Freezes $823 Million
articles.snippet: Binance says it has set aside $6.34 billion to cover losses from the breach and the FBI and Secret Service are now working with the exchange as investigators trace the stolen funds.

articles.title: What is EIP-7702? The Ethereum Upgrade Behind the $6.4B Binance Hack
articles.snippet: EIP-7702 lets ordinary Ethereum wallets run smart contract code, enabling batched and sponsored transactions. Here's how it works.
